core_obligations: Resolve i_* O_X by the Koszul complex, conclude that its Chern classes are defined, and obtain the vanishing below r together with the formula for c_r from Lemma labelled lemma-compute-koszul (proof lines 12565-12580).
Rewrite c_r using duality as a class of a bundle admitting a section vanishing exactly along i(X) (proof lines 12582-12586).

Reduce to the test identity p^*(pi_*(c_r(pi^*C^vee otimes O_E(1)) cap [W])) = j^*[W] for integral W in the two cases (disjoint from C, or pi^{-1}Y), and evaluate using the section and the top Chern class lemma (proof lines 12588-12610).
proof_roadmap: Koszul resolution and the two class computations (proof lines 12565-12586).
Reduction to the effect on a cycle class of E (proof lines 12588-12596).
The two cases for an integral W and the conclusion (proof lines 12598-12610).
difficulty_reason: For a locally free sheaf C of rank r on X, the lemma considers the morphisms X -> E = Proj_X(Sym^*(C)[T]) -> X and asserts that c_t(i_* O_X) = 0 for t = 1, ..., r - 1 and that p^* o pi_* o c_r(i_* O_X) = (-1)^{r - 1} (r - 1)! j^* in A^0(C -> E), where j : C -> E and p : C -> X are the structure maps of the vector bundle C (statement lines 12541-12563). The proof first resolves i_* O_X by the Koszul complex on the map pi^*C otimes O_E(-1) -> O_E, which vanishes exactly along i(X), so that i_* O_X is perfect with defined Chern classes; the vanishing for t < r comes from Lemma labelled lemma-compute-koszul, which also gives c_r(i_* O_X) = -(r-1)! c_r(pi^*C otimes O_E(-1)) (proof lines 12565-12580). Lemma labelled lemma-chern-classes-dual rewrites the latter as (-1)^r c_r(pi^*C^vee otimes O_E(1)), a bundle with a section s vanishing exactly along i(X) (proof lines 12582-12586). After replacing X by a scheme locally of finite type over X, the proof reduces the equality to the effect of both sides on an element alpha in CH_*(E): since C -> X is a vector bundle every cycle class on C is p^* beta by Lemma labelled lemma-vectorbundle, so Lemma labelled lemma-restrict-to-open lets alpha be written as pi^* beta + gamma with gamma supported on E minus C, and it suffices to check p^*(pi_*(c_r(pi^*C^vee otimes O_E(1)) cap [W])) = j^*[W] for integral W either disjoint from C or of the form pi^{-1}Y, where the section s and Lemma labelled lemma-top-chern-class give 0 in case (a) and [i(Y)] in case (b) (proof lines 12588-12610; the author ends with 'The result follows easily from this; details omitted'). Recognising that the cycle class on the projective bundle decomposes into a pulled back part and a part supported off the vector bundle, and then reading off the two cases from the zero locus of the section, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
